EPISODE_NARRATIVE: On the night of June 21 and into the early morning hours of June 22, several strong thunderstorms developed across the Houston area, producing strong wind gusts and flash flooding.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Heavy rain resulted in knee-deep water covering roadways near the intersection of Jensen Dr and Bennington St in Houston. A car was flooded as a result.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Thunderstorms producing heavy rain resulted in flash flooding across portions of SE TX.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Emergency managers reported that floodwaters over roads near the intersection of Hilbig and Holloman resulted in road closures.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Strong thunderstorms producing heavy rain resulted in Flash Flooding across portions of Harris and Austin Counties.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Floodwaters covered SH-288 near Holcombe Blvd in Downtown Houston.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A series of thunderstorms resulted in flash flooding in Brazoria and Fort Bend counties.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Feeder roads and the FM 1093 exit along State Highway 99 were closed due to flooding.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Showers and thunderstorms moved across the area in the evening through late night hours and produced wind damage, lightning damage and some flooding.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: An underpass was flooded along Interstate 69 South near East Mount Houston Rd, resulting in at least one stalled vehicle.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A series of thunderstorms resulted in flash flooding in Brazoria and Fort Bend counties.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Vehicles were flooded in Sweeny due to heavy rain.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A strong afternoon thunderstorm resulted in flash flooding across portions of Central Harris County.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Roadway flooding occurred along the I-10 Frontage Road and in areas surrounding the Memorial City Mall. Multiple cars were stalled as a result of the floodwaters.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: Widespread street flooding occurred across the City of Houston as the collision of two boundaries resulted in the development of near-stationary strong thunderstorms. Additionally, frequent lightning strikes resulted in some property damage.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Numerous roads were impassable due to floodwaters across the Houston area, especially in and around the West University Place and Galleria areas. Many vehicles were stalled due to the rapid rise of water levels.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A cluster of showers and thunderstorms developed over SE TX during the morning of October 1, producing periods of heavy rain across the area. Heavy downpours resulted in several instances of street flooding making roads impassable.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Heavy rainfall resulted in the US 90 underpass at Thompson Rd becoming impassable due to floodwaters.

EPISODE_NARRATIVE: A series of thunderstorms produced heavy rainfall over Galveston County, resulting in flooding in the Bacliff area.
EVENT_NARRATIVE: Heavy rain resulted in high water over roadways, making streets impassable. At least 25 structures including many within the Bacliff Villas subdivision were inundated with floodwaters, resulting in water damage.
